proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13952 haḍḍa gives Punjabi haḍḍī, western hāḍ and the addendum’s hāṛko/hāḍkī/hāḍgu bone forms. This supports Gojri aḍḍi with initial h-loss and Nimadi hāḍkā; it does not equate unexplained final clusters or suffixes automatically. Joint comparison: Bhilali haḍkā “bone” matches reviewed Nimadi hāḍkā “bone” (f_sahsjfgljzsmk). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
